correctness.rationale: For connected simple noncomplete strongly regular graphs, the Laplacian spectrum {0,alpha=k-r,beta=k-s} has alpha+beta=S=2k-lambda+mu and alpha beta=P=mu v. Exact rational functional calculus with g(z)=12z/(z²+6z+12) and the two nonconstant projectors gives adjacent off-diagonal 12h(12+6mu h-mu(v-S)h²)/D and nonedge 12mu h²(6+S h)/D, where D=d(alpha h)d(beta h)>0. Adjacent entries have exactly one positive zero H=(3+sqrt(9+12(v-S)/mu))/(v-S) when v-S>0; for v-S<=0 they remain positive. Nonedge entries stay positive. The scalar Padé stability R(z)=((z-3)²+3)/(z²+6z+12) is in (0,1] for z>=0, so the matrix is SPD, row stochastic algebraically, and norm 1 for all h. Three independent exact rational C5 inverse matrix checks matched the offdiagonal formulas, but the spectral calculation establishes the universal theorem.

value.rationale: Exact all-parameter sharp positive-time horizon for a natural infinite family of reversible graph diffusions under a fourth-order implicit integrator. Separates positivity from spectral stability and exhibits permanent edge-sign loss; covers primitive as well as imprimitive strongly regular graphs. The parameter formula is potentially useful for deciding admissible steps from graph invariants alone.
